migration_supersession_impacts.detail: The s4 bloom modal (shelves + horizontal rail, cmd.settings.bloom.open) is superseded by a full Settings Workspace with left navigation in all four concepts; bloom survives only as a possible quick-access alias.
Left Activity Bar canon applied: rail controls one adjacent LEFT side-panel slot; assistant panel is right-side only as the chat panel, and no stale right-side-panel Settings descriptions were used.

Conversation mode and access profile decoupled: Personas row 'behavior-not-authority' states a Persona cannot grant Full Access; access profiles (Ask/Auto accept edits/Auto/Full Access) are separate from Plan/Review effect limits.
Auto/Inherit/Not configured/Disabled never rendered as unexplained empty strings; explicit value states (Not configured, Managed, Auto, Unavailable with reason) shown in row grammar.

media destination removed; continuation settings moved into the Provider manager; honest not-configured audio row kept as a Desktop fixture; video output kept searchable as an unavailable-capability exemplar.
